author: Qixit
body:
Boundaries is a semi-large map with two teams competing against eachother, trying to get as many points before 15 minutes is up. There is an iron ingot spawner in the middle of the map, so players can craft iron armour and stuffs. You can build on this map, within suitable areas (not spawns) as well as dig underneath the playing field.
Map Features:
15 minutes
25v25
Iron Spawner

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map overall looks very nice. Its very well terraformed and it has a nicely chosen block palette.

Looking at this picture (http://i.imgur.com/aCf1fN6.png) the clay areas in the water IMO stand out too much. They are a good idea but executed a bit poorly.

I really like the custom trees but you should add some more of them on the edges of the map. I also like the small piles of rocks on the map that give some, but not too much cover.

Overall pretty nice map, has a nice layout and a very nice block palette. I really like the use of pistons. I just suggest some broken down buildings on the map to provide some more cover.
